name: Domo Activos, S.A.
summary: Domo Activos, S.A., a real estate investment company, purchases, constructs, sells, and rents real estate properties in Spain. It establishes and manages investment vehicles; provides advisory services for purchase or sale of assets, as well as rent or sale of real estate properties; manages asset portfolios; supervises or manages buildings and their facilities; and administration, relationship with the tenants, collections, repairs, etc. The company is based in Madrid, Spain.
